objectives.en: Distinguish virtual reality from augmented reality
Define a robot and give examples

narration.en: A trainee pilot "flies" a plane through a storm without leaving the ground. A rover drives on Mars with nobody on board. How?
narration.kn: ತರಬೇತಿ ಪೈಲಟ್ ನೆಲ ಬಿಡದೆ ಬಿರುಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಮಾನ "ಹಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ". ಯಾರೂ ಇಲ್ಲದ ರೋವರ್ ಮಂಗಳನ ಮೇಲೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೇಗೆ?

body.en: Immersive experiences let users feel they are inside or interacting with a computer-created world. Virtual Reality (VR) is a three-dimensional, computer-generated environment that replaces the real world; the user wears a headset and may use hand controllers. It is used in gaming, flight and driving simulators and medical training. Augmented Reality (AR) superimposes computer-generated information, such as images, labels or directions, on the user's view of the real world, usually through a phone camera or smart glasses.

points.en: VR: fully computer-generated world, replaces reality
AR: digital information added on top of the real world
AR uses: navigation arrows on a camera view, try-on apps, labelled science models

narration.kn: ವರ್ಚುವಲ್ ರಿಯಾಲಿಟಿ (VR) ನೈಜ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಬದಲು ಗಣಕ ನಿರ್ಮಿತ 3D ಪರಿಸರ; ಹೆಡ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆಗ್ಮೆಂಟೆಡ್ ರಿಯಾಲಿಟಿ (AR) ನೈಜ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ದೃಶ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಣಕ ನಿರ್ಮಿತ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಫೋನ್ ಕ್ಯಾಮೆರಾ ಮೂಲಕ.

title.en: On the board: From AR to VR, and how a robot works

say.en: Think of a line. At one end is the real world; at the other is a world made entirely by the computer.
Augmented reality adds computer images on top of the real world, like a game character on your camera view.
Virtual reality replaces the real world completely: you wear a headset and see only the computer’s 3D world.
A robot senses its surroundings, decides what to do, and acts. Then it senses again.
The actuators change the surroundings, and the sensors measure that change. This loop runs again and again.

text.en: Examples: welding arm, Mars rover, drone

narration.en: We place augmented and virtual reality on a line from the real world to a fully virtual one, then draw a robot’s sense–think–act loop.

body.en: A robot is a machine that can carry out a complex series of actions automatically, using sensors to sense its surroundings and actuators to move. Robots weld and paint in car factories, assist in surgery, and explore places dangerous for humans; NASA's Mars rovers are robots. Sophia is a humanoid robot that uses AI to hold conversations. A drone is an unmanned aerial vehicle, flown by remote control or autonomously, used for surveys, crop spraying, delivery and disaster relief.

points.en: Industrial, medical, space and humanoid robots

A drone is an unmanned aerial vehicle, flown by remote control or autonomously, used for surveys, crop spraying, delivery and disaster relief.
narration.kn: ರೋಬೋಟ್ ಸಂವೇದಕಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಸುತ್ತಮುತ್ತ ಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ, ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಯಂತ್ರ. ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ, ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಮಂಗಳ ಗ್ರಹದ ಅನ್ವೇಷಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಡ್ರೋನ್ ಮಾನವರಹಿತ ವೈಮಾನಿಕ ವಾಹನ.

problem.en: Identify the technology: (a) a headset game where you walk inside a castle (b) a phone app that shows arrows on the live camera view of a road (c) an unmanned machine that sprays pesticide over a field.

steps.en: (a) replaces the real world with a computer-made one, so it is virtual reality.
(b) adds digital arrows on the real view, so it is augmented reality.
(c) is an unmanned aerial vehicle, a drone, which is a kind of robot.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Identify the technology: (a) a headset game where you walk inside a castle (b) a phone app that shows arrows on the live camera view of a road (c) an unmanned machine that sprays pesticide over a field.

homework.en: Find two uses of AR and two of VR in education or healthcare.

narration.en: Recap. VR builds a complete computer-generated world. AR adds digital information to the real world. Robots sense and act automatically; drones are unmanned aerial vehicles.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. VR ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಗಣಕ ನಿರ್ಮಿತ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ರಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. AR ನೈಜ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ರೋಬೋಟ್‌ಗಳು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ; ಡ್ರೋನ್ ಮಾನವರಹಿತ ವೈಮಾನಿಕ ವಾಹನ.
